subject: Winter blackout: need to move FastPay integration demo
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@fastpay.com>
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quarterly integration demo: Dec 28?

Hi Stephanie / Ben,

Hope you’re both well. We’re wrapping up our internal procurement review and would like to schedule the product integration demo you showed at the intro call. Would Dec 28 at 10:00 AM PT work for your team?

Proposed attendees from FastPay: Alyssa (product), Tom (platform).

I attached a short agenda (agenda-fastpay-demo.pdf) — main goals are 1) full walk-through of the API, 2) embeddings/semantic search fit, 3) SLAs & data residency questions.

If Dec 28 is tight, we’re flexible around that week — please let me know a couple of alternatives.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Product Manager | FastPay
alyssa@fastpay.com

Attachment: agenda-fastpay-demo.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@fastpay.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly integration demo: Dec 28?

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the agenda and the proposed slot. Really appreciate the clarity on goals.

Quick heads up: Redwood has a planned company winter blackout this year and most customer-facing teams will be out or running reduced coverage from Dec 24 through Jan 2. That makes Dec 28 a blackout date for our demo engineers and support coverage.

Options I can offer right now (short summary):
- Move to the first week back: Jan 4–8. I have two tentative windows: Jan 5 at 11:00 AM ET (08:00 AM PT) or Jan 6 at 2:00 PM ET (11:00 AM PT). Those are best for Ben and our product engineer.
- If you need something before the shutdown, we can do a condensed 40-minute session during Dec 21–23 with limited Q&A (Ben will be on limited availability).
- Alternate: record a short walkthrough now and pair it with a live Q&A the first week of Jan.

I pasted your original note below for context. I’ve also attached an .ics file with the two Jan slots and the Dec squeeze option so you can drop one into your calendar (redwood-reschedule-options.ics).

Can you confirm which of these works for FastPay? If Jan 5 works, I’ll send a calendar invite and loop in one of our CS reps for follow-up.

Thanks — and sorry for the inconvenience around the year-end blackout.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0123

Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@fastpay.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly integration demo: Dec 28?

Thanks for the quick reply, Stephanie — that timeline makes sense. We don’t want to rush things during the holidays, so Jan 5 at 11:00 AM ET is ideal for our team. Please send the invite and include any pre-read or the session recording if you happen to produce one.

Tom and I are available for the full hour. If you can loop in a CS rep, that would be perfect so we can talk onboarding and next steps during the sync.

Looking forward to it — thanks for working around the blackout.

Best,
Alyssa
